description: Open Data Armenia: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open Data Armenia, an open data portal (CKAN) run by a civil-society initiative, published or maintained by Open Data Armenia. Coverage: Open Data Armenia. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Life in Transition Survey (LITS); Institution Building and Growth in Transition Economies 1987-2002; Subways and urban growth: Evidence from Earth; Life in Transition Survey 2006. Formats seen: HTML, CSV, ZIP, VECTOR API, TEXT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is License not specified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opendata-am.
